interpretation: Response obligations that can be injectively matched to legal defender response turns form a transversal matroid on the obligation set.
A repair obligation that makes an independent response set dependent creates a matroid circuit; retaining the repair requires dropping some existing circuit obligation.
This gives an exact algebraic basis for defect transfer once coverage-essential response obligations are connected to WSL requirements.
claim_boundary: This control validates the intended small finite formulation. The transversal-matroid statement itself follows from the standard matching definition; this evidence does not yet map every Connect Four strategic certificate into one such obligation matroid.
